subject: mathematics_2a
question_text: A speaks truth in 75% of the cases and B in 80% of the cases. What is the probability that their statements about an incident do not match?

mark_split.label: Events and the two truth probabilities
Do not match = (A true, B false) or (A false, B true)

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the probability that A and B contradict each other — the events, the two ways it can happen, and why they are added.
insider_note: "Do not match" happens in TWO disjoint ways; each way is a product (independent) and the two are added (mutually exclusive). Both words must be used.

steps.label: Events and truth probabilities
steps.margin_note: First mark. Convert the percentages: 75% = 3/4, 80% = 4/5. A and B speak independently.

lines.text: Let A, B be the events that A and B speak the
truth respectively. They are independent, and

recall.must_convey: That A and B are the events of each speaking the truth, independent, with P(A) = 3/4 and P(B) = 4/5.
accept: let A and B be speaking the truth with probabilities three quarters and four fifths
A is true with 3 by 4 and B with 4 by 5, independent
convert 75 percent to 3 by 4 and 80 percent to 4 by 5
A nijam cheppe event 3 by 4, B 4 by 5, independent

steps.why: The statements match when both are true or both are false; they do not match when exactly one is true. The events must be named before that can be written.
common_mistakes: Leaving the values as 75 and 80 instead of fractions.
Not saying the two people speak independently.

steps.label: Complements
steps.margin_note: Second mark. P(Aᶜ) = 1/4 and P(Bᶜ) = 1/5: the chance each one does not speak the truth.

accept: A lies with a quarter and B lies with a fifth
P A complement is 1 by 4 and P B complement is 1 by 5
the complements are one by four and one by five
A abaddham cheppe probability 1 by 4, B 1 by 5

steps.why: Each "does not match" case has one person not speaking the truth, so each case needs one complement.

steps.label: Two ways to contradict
steps.margin_note: Two marks. E = (A ∩ Bᶜ) ∪ (Aᶜ ∩ B). The two cases cannot both happen, so add; inside each case the events are independent, so multiply.

lines.text: Let E = their statements do not match, i.e.
exactly one of them speaks the truth:

accept: do not match is A true B false or A false B true so three quarters times a fifth plus a quarter times four fifths equals seven by twenty
add the two exclusive cases each a product, 3 by 20 plus 4 by 20 is 7 by 20
rendu cases add cheyyali, 3 by 4 into 1 by 5 plus 1 by 4 into 4 by 5, 7 by 20
heard_as: three by twenty plus four by twenty

steps.why: The two cases are mutually exclusive (exactly one person is truthful in each, but a different one), so their probabilities add; each case is a product because the two people are independent.
common_mistakes: Answering P(both true) + P(both false) = 13/20, the probability that they DO match.
